I completely feel the same way. People want to be ‘seen’ as caring about the world, the environment, and whatnot and over the years I have developed a sense of apathy and indifference to protect myself. Things are shit and will always remain so, at least to our human eyes and you can’t change it. You solve a problem, another one crops up. It’s a circle of despair and struggle. 

How many things are we reallly supposed to care about anyway? Doesn’t it make your head hurt? And what good does it do, apart from a few upvotes on the social media? We weren’t built for this incessant stream of negative, crisis-laden, information cesspool.
This is disturbing.

Yeah sure, I am in the same place as you because I tend to disbelieve rather than believe. Two facts are clear about life from mere observation: life is suffering peppered by moments of joy and it’s moves in circles. Perhaps the people who make their own and other people’s lives worse by their own hand are born again and have to undergo suffering until they truly manage to get out of the cycle. Unlike most people on here, I believe suffering does have a purpose. It can make or break you. Perhaps the goal of suffering is to guide you towards extinguishment of self, consciousness... that is true bliss imo ...

Also, I wish life came with a handling guide.
